title: Logs
clearConfirm: Clear the log? This cannot be undone.
exportConfirm: Export a diagnostics bundle? It includes the full log, your display preferences, and device info, plus your repository settings when the app is unlocked (remote host, commit identity, trusted public keys). Secret fields like access tokens, SSH keys, and passphrases are replaced with [REDACTED]. You'll choose where to save it next — share it only with someone you trust.
verboseOffHint: Turn on to capture everything (Debug level) for about 10 minutes to attach to a bug report.
verboseOnHint: Debug logging is on. It reverts to Info on your next launch after the window elapses ({remaining} left).
verboseElapsedHint: The verbose window has elapsed. Logging stays at Debug until your next launch or you turn it off.
verboseActiveToast: Verbose logging is on — reverts to Info on next launch ({remaining} left).
verboseBootNotifBody: Still on — reverts to Info on next launch ({remaining} left).
verboseRevertedNotifBody: Reverted to Info — the debug window elapsed.
